summary: Accept nominal reconstruction and publication within existing authority, conditional on digital checks. Confidence high in approach, medium in community dimensions and reconstructed detail.
findings: The PCB 17.78 × 33.1 mm and overall 34.624 mm length remain community nominal values; 3.2 mm height and mid-mount USB are manufacturer-backed.
Scalloped ledges at Z=8.1–8.8 mm may restore nominal support. Verify positive contact area and clear sockets, contacts and solder reserves.
Translate the same commercial geometry between halves. Preserve separate visible nice!view geometry and V-cut reserve.
Retain the unresolved connector gap; do not lengthen visual pins to imply contact.
Record source revision, hash and license per reused model; physical fit and publication authority are not established by review.
confidence: High in evidence and bounded approach; medium in unverified implementation, interoperability and inferred dimensions. No physical acceptance.
